limitations: Reviewer infrastructure classifications are distinct from native finals; no final time, size, compute history or key-release state is fabricated.
Raw-native-summary.json intentionally retains missing-final runs as unresolved.
Exploration and confirmation remain separate; small samples do not prove a long-term success probability.
Compute statistics exclude incomplete decision arrays from interrupted runs; this creates incomplete timing coverage.
Infrastructure failures count against the precommitted operational target and do not by themselves identify a strategy-logic failure.
